method: Fixed 120Hz, full-state heuristic pilot. Only legal combat inputs and offered menu decisions. No hull, timer or progression overrides. Not a human difficulty study.

chronicle.text: The Notary remembers every shot. It offers you terms because the first pilot who refuses them becomes a warning.
The Choir was built to agree. Now its voices disagree only on how you should fall.
The Sovereign guards a crown no one wears. Beyond its throne, three forbidden constellations wait.
A leviathan carries the archive on its back. The oldest record is a pilot who returned every bullet.
The Weaver cultivates futures in glass. Every reflected shot is a future it did not predict.
The final guardian has no name. It exists only to ask whether a promise matters when nobody can enforce it.
